findings.message: RUN-001 FINDING 1 (three regions stated inconsistently) - RESOLVED. Verified independently by grepping every occurrence across the unit, the figure manifest and the SVG. docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-05/topic-04.mdx now reads "the third region" at lines 61, 66, 142, 158 and 159; unit-assessment.mdx line 48 reads "effort spent in the third region"; the fig-U5-7 alt text at topic-04.mdx line 24 and the Alt column of specs/content/efmp-302/figures/unit-05.md line 19 both read "the third region of what they do not control". Zero occurrences of "outside all three" or "outside all of it" remain in the unit sources or in the built HTML. static/img/figures/efmp-302/unit-05/fig-U5-7.svg additionally carries a panel titled "The three regions exhaust the situation" reading "Every part of a teacher's working life sits in exactly one of them. There is no fourth place to stand." topic-04.mdx "Check your understanding" item 2 is now answerable as written.

RUN-001 FINDING 1, SECOND CLAUSE (reconcile the teacher notes with topic-04's placement of class size) - STILL OPEN, at reduced severity. docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-05/unit-teacher-notes.mdx line 78 now reads "Unit 1's professional associations and Topic 5.4's second region, what you can influence, are where collective pressure belongs". topic-04.mdx lines 56-58 place class size, pay scales and the examination system in the THIRD region, and lines 68-70 say that teachers collectively "are exactly who should be pressing on that" - i.e. on third-region matters. The note therefore still locates collective pressure in region two while the learner text aims it at region three, and the note then lists "what to endure, what to change and what to organise about" as three distinct categories, which is a different partition again. A coherent reading exists (acting collectively is how a region-three matter becomes influenceable) and the new fig-U5-7 panel "The regions are not fixed. A teacher who builds standing over a term moves items from the third region into the second" supplies it - but no prose anywhere states it, so the reconciliation run 001 asked for was not performed. Advisory because the defect is confined to a teacher-facing ancillary file and no learner-facing item depends on it.

RUN-001 FINDING 2 (U5-07/U5-08 grounded in hargreaves2000) - PARTIALLY RESOLVED, and the residue is blocking. Judged independently against the bound excerpt specs/content/efmp-302/sources/texts/demirkasimoglu2010.md. RESOLVED for U5-08: coverage/unit-05.md line 23 now grounds "Socio-economic status and public recognition" in demirkasimoglu2010, and topic-02.mdx lines 107-109 ("opens from the long argument over whether teaching is a profession or a semi-profession, given the limits placed on teacher autonomy and decision-making") is a faithful paraphrase of that record summary's own opening sentence. STILL OPEN for U5-07: coverage/unit-05.md line 22 grounds "High expectations from many stakeholders at once" in demirkasimoglu2010, but (a) that section of topic-02.mdx, lines 76-103, contains no citation at all, and (b) the bound record is a review of how teacher professionalism is DEFINED - three interpretive approaches, ideological control / positive attitude / integrative framework - and says nothing about stakeholder demand analysis or the want-versus-measure gap that is the whole content of U5-07. One unrelated key (hargreaves2000) has been replaced by a different unrelated key. Repair: mark U5-07 no-external-source, or ground it in a source that actually addresses competing stakeholder expectations.

NEW, introduced by the run-001 repair. specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-05.md line 52 still records hargreaves2000 as supporting "topic-02.mdx U5-07, U5-08", while specs/content/efmp-302/coverage/unit-05.md line 21 now maps hargreaves2000 to U5-06. The two governance files contradict each other on the same key. The sources row is also internally inconsistent: its own Supports gloss reads "the demand for accountability as part of a long historical movement in how societies relate to teaching", which describes U5-06, not U5-07 or U5-08. The coverage matrix was repaired and the sources file was not. Repair: change the hargreaves2000 Supports cell to topic-02.mdx U5-06.

NEW, introduced by the run-001 repair. topic-02.mdx line 107 cites "Demirkasimoglu (2010)" in the learner-facing prose, but topic-02.mdx's "## Further reading" (lines 228-234) lists only Isore (2009) and Hargreaves (2000). RUN-001 FINDING 3 (approved MCQ blueprint violated) - STILL OPEN, unchanged in substance. Option order was permuted but no item's topic assignment changed. specs/content/efmp-302/content-spec.md line 116 ("## Unit 5" > "Unit-end assessment blueprint") requires "MCQs (10): Remember to Apply; **at least 2 per topic** across 5.1 to 5.4". Mapping each item in unit-assessment.mdx "### Multiple-choice questions (MCQs)" to its topic: items 1-4 are topic 5.1 (invisible workload, burnout dimension, burnout vs stress, home language), items 5-7 are topic 5.2 (accountability, want vs measure, status), item 8 alone is topic 5.3 (the three technology questions), items 9-10 are topic 5.4 (region misuse, resilience). Topic 5.3 therefore carries ONE MCQ, not two, and sub-topic U5-10 (responsible use of digital platforms and resources) carries none - corroborated by specs/content/efmp-302/concepts/unit-05.md line 32, where CON:EFMP-302-5-15 lists only RRQ-08 and ERQ-03. RUN-001 FINDING 5 (ERQ 5 / Mr Bilal rubric conflict) - STILL OPEN; the parent confirms it was not repaired, and this reviewer judges it afresh as a genuine conflict of assessment criteria. unit-assessment.mdx line 281 makes the Strong band of ERQ 5's Diagnosis criterion "Identifies the cynicism dimension in the group-work remark and supports it from the text", and unit-teacher-notes.mdx lines 109-111 hardens this to "It REQUIRES the cynicism dimension to be recognised". The ERQ 5 stem (line 172-173) gives the teacher the signature remark "She has begun telling trainees not to bother with group work". topic-04.mdx lines 29-31 gives Mr Bilal a near-identical remark in near-identical circumstances - "When a trainee asks him about group work he says there is no point with these numbers. He is not wrong about the numbers" - and then diagnoses it at lines 61-64 and 157-160 NOT as cynicism but as "an accurate judgement about the third region to justify inaction in the first ... the characteristic failure of an experienced teacher in a hard system". Meanwhile topic-01's own cynicism illustration (lines 98-100) is a different remark about a weak class, not about group work. A candidate who applies Topic 5.4 - which index.mdx line 84 instructs them to read last and not skip - produces a text-supported diagnosis that the rubric's Strong band does not award, and the rubric asks them to "support it from the text" for a reading the text attaches to a different remark. Repair: either distinguish Mr Bilal's case from the burnout case in the prose, or widen the Diagnosis Strong band to credit either the cynicism reading or the region-misuse reading when defended from the text.

RUN-001 FINDING 7 (source text unobtainable for little2001) - STILL OPEN, now properly declared, and joined by a second key. specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-05.md lines 35-41 declares under "## Unverifiable sources" that no bound excerpt could be committed for little2001 or hennessy2022, and the bound tree specs/content/efmp-302/sources/texts/ confirms it: excerpts exist for 12 keys but neither of those two. Both ground REQUIRED coverage rows - little2001 is the sole source for U5-05 (the multi-grade classroom, coverage/unit-05.md line 19) and hennessy2022 the sole source for U5-09 (pressure to integrate technology, line 24). Support for both rests on title and bibliographic record only. The unit is honest about it (topic-01 line 163-165 marks the inference as its own; topic-03 lines 50-52 states the scope limit explicitly), and nothing is misrepresented. But the G3 rubric requires escalating unavailable source text, and this needs an owner decision on whether record-level citation is acceptable for two required rows, or whether retrievable substitutes must be found.

NEW. The occupational-status comparison is asserted without a source and without the disclosure the unit uses elsewhere. topic-02.mdx lines 118-122 makes empirical comparative claims about Pakistan - that teaching "typically has lower pay, a less selective entry route and less day-to-day autonomy" than medicine or law, and "greater security, substantial social respect in some communities" than many other occupations - and fig-U5-4 renders the same comparison as a TABLE across teaching, medicine, law, engineering and nursing on pay, entry selectivity, autonomy and recognition, which presents it to the learner as established fact. coverage/unit-05.md line 23 grounds U5-08 in demirkasimoglu2010, but the bound record supports only the framing sentence at lines 107-109, not any of these markers. Unlike topic-01's multilingual practices (lines 152-154, "This unit cites no research for those practices ... offered as reasoned practice ... not as findings") and unlike index.mdx's standing note (lines 34-39), this section carries NO disclosure that the comparison is reasoned rather than evidenced. Either source the comparison or add the same disclosure the unit applies to its other unsourced claims.

NEW, minor. The narrow-viewport rubric tables on unit-assessment are their own scroll container - computed display:block, overflow-x:auto, tabindex="0" - so the off-screen "Strong (4-5)" column IS reachable by keyboard and touch and the document does not scroll horizontally. That satisfies the accessibility requirement and is recorded as verified. The focusable scroll region carries no `role="region"` and no `aria-label`, so a screen-reader user reaching it by Tab gets no announcement of what they have landed in. Worth adding when the shared table component is next touched; not specific to this unit.

NEW, minor. static/img/figures/efmp-302/unit-05/fig-U5-7.svg asserts "The regions are not fixed. A teacher who builds standing over a term moves items from the third region into the second." No prose in topic-04.mdx says this, and it sits in mild tension with line 58, "no amount of individual effort moves them". The claim is defensible and is the reading that would reconcile the teacher-notes gloss, but a figure should not be the only place a substantive claim is made. Either state it in the prose or drop it from the figure.
